definitions.gloss: elderly person, old person, senior citizen
definitions.explanation: A person of advanced age; typically refers to those in their later years of life.

examples.japanese: {老人|ろうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}った→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave up my seat to an elderly person.

examples.japanese: {老人|ろうじん}⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a nursing home.
examples.notes: {老人|ろうじん}⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧ = nursing home, retirement home

notes:
USAGE: {老人|ろうじん} is a neutral term for elderly people. In more polite or formal contexts, ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧ (senior citizen) or お⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧ (elderly person, polite) may be preferred.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {老人|ろうじん}⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧ (nursing home)
- {老人|ろうじん}⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧ (elderly welfare)
- {老人|ろうじん}⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧ (elderly care)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {老人|ろうじん} - neutral, somewhat clinical
- お⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧ - polite, softer
- ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧ - formal, administrative term
